# Kinship Map — persona / register kinship only

Audience kinship is derived from profile pointers in `registry.md`; this file records only which personas and registers are siblings, so a new channel inherits its nearest sibling's psychology as labeled hypotheses and so register-locked formats transfer to the right places.

- **Veteran American tradesman / craftsman (faceless voiceover):** Roger the Pipe Guy and the plumbing siblings ↔ Dale Oakfield's Workshop. Same register: practical, thrifty, "in 45/40 years…", big-box anchors native. Nearest sibling for any new trade niche. **Dale's register shifted 2026-09-09 to hustle-thrifty (money-in)** — same family, money earned instead of money saved; he keeps the tenure and the big-box anchor.
- **Money-in / hustle-thrifty (woodworking for profit, added 2026-09-09):** Dale Oakfield's Workshop (faceless, pivoted) ↔ **Hank Hardwood** (face, AI-avatar presenter) — for-profit twins on one topic pool, differentiated by the format-flip and the collision audit (woodworking `steering.md` §5). Hank's face-channel doctrine is inherited from **Werner Finkbinder** (synthetic presenter, disclosure, persona verdicts, no on-camera demonstration). Nearest siblings for any future monetization-angle channel in another niche (plumbing-for-landlords, sewing-for-profit).
- **Heritage-plain / built-to-last:** Sawdust Sam (Amish/traditional woodworking, faceless) ↔ Hannah Yoder (Amish textiles, face). Same register: hand methods, no-electricity line, "made to last generations", never micro-cost or speed framing, real tradition only. F19 / F29 / F2 / F22 / F26 home lanes.
- **Granny-cozy (face):** Granny Mae (crochet) ↔ Pearl Parker (knitting, brisker) ↔ Quilting + Sewing face granny (Tennessee, rural warmth). Same register; persona specials in the granny key; soft uncheckable backstories only.
- **Mastery / precision:** Master Kenji ↔ **Werner Finkbinder** (plumbing, face; German-precision = mastery-precision × tradesman-practical — added 2026-09-07). Kenji's register: mastery not thrift, "the secret the West never learned"; the F36/F37 "…from MASTERS" key. Werner keeps the precision key but, unlike Kenji, micro-cost and big-box anchors are native to him. Werner's other siblings: Roger (topic world, tradesman thrift) and Hannah Yoder (the lens doctrine — proven topics re-made as "the [Tradition] way of X", a truth doctrine of real practice only, synthetic presenter with disclosure). Werner is the nearest sibling for any future national-lens persona (the Italian way, the Japanese way).
- **Neutral-clean (faceless, brand voice):** Crochet Decoded ↔ Knitting with Nora (a named voice persona, never a face) ↔ Quilting + Sewing (faceless, owns the machine lane). Same doctrine and register; nearest siblings for any new faceless craft channel.
- **Aesthetic-girly (F46):** no owning channel since the amigurumi channel was binned (Aug 2026); the register is banked in the master and described in the `audience-profiles.md` register note — there is no profile for it (operator call 2026-09-06).
